source.name: Charlotte FC: 'Charlotte FC Reveals New Primary Kit Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: Ally Financial, Charlotte FC’s lead and founding partner, is represented as the front-of-kit sponsor as it has for each kit in the Club’s history.
source.note: Club announcement of the 2026 primary kit, the Carolina Kit: Crowns Up by adidas. For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor review (2026-02-17) lists the same front partner: 'Charlotte FC | Ally | Financial Services'.

source.name: Charlotte FC: 'Charlotte FC Reveals New Primary Kit Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: Rugs.com will also be the sleeve sponsor for the third season and can be found on the right sleeve of the kit.
source.note: Rugs.com became the club's official sleeve partner in July 2024 (club announcement of 2024-07-02); the 2026 kit release confirms the third season on the right sleeve.

source.name: Sportico: 'MLS to Allow Teams to Sell Ads on Lower Back of Jerseys'
source.quote: A second sleeve patch was sold to Apple, the league’s media partner, for all 30 teams.
source.note: League-wide left-sleeve patch; For Soccer's 2026 review lists Apple TV on the left sleeve of every MLS club, including Charlotte FC.

source.name: Charlotte FC: 'Charlotte FC Names Frigidaire as First-Ever Back-of-Kit Partner'
source.quote: logo will appear below player numbers on the back of all Charlotte FC kits
source.note: Full sentence on the page: 'Beginning with this weekend's match against the Columbus Crew, the Frigidaire® logo will appear below player numbers on the back of all Charlotte FC kits.' MLS opened the lower-back ad space after the 2026 All-Star break.

summary: The Carolina Kit: Crowns Up, the club's 2026 primary kit by adidas. Ally Financial is on the front for the fifth season; Rugs.com is on the right sleeve for a third season; the league-wide Apple TV+ patch sits on the left sleeve; from August 2026 Frigidaire's logo appears below the numbers on the back under a new MLS back-of-kit asset.
